source_refs.note: Diode as a Rectifier: a main subheading of 17.14 Rectification, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 106-106.

blocks.text: A diode allows large current to flow when forward biased. However, the current through a reverse biased diode is practically zero. It is due to this important property of the diode that it can be used for rectification i.e., to convert alternating current into unidirectional current or direct current.

blocks.title: Brain teaser
blocks.text:
Cell phones store AC or DC!
Cell phone batteries store DC in them, since it is easier to store DC than AC. DC is also safer compared to AC. The electric grid provides AC only. Therefore, the AC is converted to DC using a rectifier before charging the cell phones or any other portable devices such as laptops, flashlights, etc.
